George Reddy (2026) | South Hindi Dubbed Movie | Sandeep Madhav, Satyadev | Telugu Action Film

Synopsis
The Protagonist: The film chronicles the life of George Reddy, a charismatic student leader, physics scholar, gold medalist, and boxer at Osmania University in Hyderabad.
Activism and Politics: Set in the late 1960s and early 1970s (roughly 1967 to 1972), George rises as a fearless voice against social inequality, caste discrimination, and right-wing student politics on campus.
The Conflict: His radical Marxist-Leninist ideals and growing influence over the student movement make him a massive threat to rival factions and political opponents.
Tragic End: Despite his intellectual brilliance and physical prowess as a boxer, he is ambushed and brutally murdered by opponents at his college hostel in 1972 at the age of 22.

Synopsis
The Main Characters: Vijay Antony plays a dual role as Vijay Gurumoorthy, a wealthy and powerful business tycoon, and Sathya, an impoverished beggar whose life revolves around finding his long-lost sister, Raani, who was separated from him after a past tragedy.
The Brain Transplant Conspiracy: Corrupt business partners and conspirators orchestrate a plot to eliminate Vijay Gurumoorthy and perform an illegal brain transplant, placing Sathya's brain into Vijay's body (or vice versa depending on the operational twist).
The "Anti Bikili" Mission: Awakened inside the opulent world of the billionaire, Sathya uncovers the dark nexus of greed, corporate exploitation, and wealth disparity. He adopts the philosophy of fighting the wealthy elite whom he terms "Bikili".
Resolution: Sathya uses Vijay's immense wealth, influence, and network to help the poor by launching the Anti Bikili Foundation. After taking down the conspirators, he transfers his properties to Hema (Kavya Thapar), reunites with his sister Raani, and chooses to serve a prison sentence for his actions.

recentItems.title: Shadaa (2026) | Punjabi Romantic Comedy Movie | Diljit Dosanjh, Neeru Bajwa | Sonam Bajwa Film
recentItems.description:
Shadaa (2026) | Punjabi Romantic Comedy Movie | Diljit Dosanjh, Neeru Bajwa | Sonam Bajwa Film

Synopsis
Amidst pressures from his parents to hurry up and wed, a young man Chadta seeks his perfect match. After many failed attempts with matchmakers, his parents are delighted when their son finally meets the woman, Vanjhali of his dreams but things do not go as planned. Chadta and Vanjhali come close in a wedding. Vanjhali is a wedding planner and Chadta a photographer. Chadta wishes to marry her but Vanjhali is against marriage and suggests Chadta to live in. They come close during a wedding in Rajasthan where they were working together. Vanjhali is able to convince Chadta that marriages are a failed institution. Soon after that she is betrothed to Bagh Singh. Bagh is a lover failed in his previous relationship. He is not really into the wedding but agrees to wed Vanjhali because she is rich and after wedding he would be a house husband and live in her large house. Chadta is assigned for the pre wedding photoshoot. He thanks Bagh for accepting Vanjhali even after knowing about her live in with Chadta. This sly remark gets her wedding cancelled. Vanjhali's mother is convinced Vanjhali must be married to Chadta to save the family name. Chadta although loves Vanjhali pretends he doesn't want to get married. On their wedding day Vanjhali goes missing as she doesn't want to forcefully wed Chadta. Chadta finds Vanjhali on her way to Shimla eating in a dhaba and confess about his love and how he broke off her wedding with Bagh Singh. Finally they get married.
